sources.title: Quantum Convex Support
sources.author: Stephan Weis
read_scope: Section1.1 Representation: state space, mean value map, linear image/affine isomorphism.
Proposition2.7 and proof: support function=max eigenvalue, exposed face supported on maximal eigenspace.
Section1.2 opening inspected; formula extraction duplicates MathML/TeX and is not used as a numerical source.
sources.finding: The PSD-affine/expectation geometry and spectral support arguments are established tools; no novelty claim for these tools.

sources.title: Quantum Statistics-Inspired Neural Attention
read_scope: Section3 through context-vector and ADM construction, equations6-8.
sources.finding: Prior token-indexed symmetric pseudo-density ADM explicitly does not enforce PSD; it averages matrix scores then applies softmax. Current proposal is fixed-dimension PSD effect scores then token normalization. That distinction does not establish novelty against other density/multihead approaches. Their mixed/off-diagonal terminology is not adopted.
